subject.title: Cron pacing can corrupt cadence across force runs, edits, and shared sessions

question: Should this cron pacing regression be sponsored as a focused scheduler correctness repair now, and who should own the cross-lifecycle design review?
rationale: The requested behavior is concrete, but it spans persisted scheduling provenance, trigger safety, update finalization, and shared-session invocation ownership; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision before automated work.

options.title: Sponsor a focused cron repair
options.body: Confirm the stated cadence and per-invocation ownership invariants, then assign a bounded implementation with regression coverage for every listed lifecycle path.

options.title: Request a minimal failing regression first
options.body: Ask for a focused current-main test that demonstrates the highest-impact shared-session or force-run failure before selecting the final repair boundary.
